purpose: Verify creation of a new file with mandatory comment and no draft edit, resulting in Draft state.
preconditions: User is an authorized Institute Employee with an assigned role. No existing file record for the intended file.
action_or_input: Create new file with initial mandatory comment. Do not add attachments. Save as draft.
expected_result: File is created in 'Draft / Pre-circulation' state. Audit log records creation.

purpose: Verify circulation of a new file without draft edit (Zero Draft-Edit Traversal).
preconditions: File exists in 'Draft / Pre-circulation' state. User is the creator/sender. Recipient is a valid Institute Employee.
action_or_input: Send/Forward file to recipient with mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: File state changes to 'Active / Circulated'. File appears in Recipient's Inbox and Sender's Outbox. Notification triggered. Movement history updated.

purpose: Verify editing a draft file once (One Draft-Edit Traversal).
preconditions: File exists in 'Draft / Pre-circulation' state. User is the creator.
action_or_input: Edit the draft file (e.g., update comment or add attachment). Save changes.
expected_result: File remains in 'Updated Draft / Pre-circulation' state. Changes are persisted.

purpose: Verify circulation of a file after one draft edit.
preconditions: File exists in 'Updated Draft / Pre-circulation' state. User is the sender. Recipient is valid.
action_or_input: Send/Forward file to recipient with mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: File state changes to 'Active / Circulated'. Notification triggered. History updated.

purpose: Verify discarding a newly created draft without editing (Zero Draft-Edit Traversal).
preconditions: File exists in 'Draft / Pre-circulation' state. User is the creator.
expected_result: File is discarded. No active file retained. Audit log records discard action.

purpose: Verify discarding a draft after one edit (One Draft-Edit Traversal).
preconditions: File exists in 'Updated Draft / Pre-circulation' state. User is the creator.
action_or_input: Select 'Discard' on the edited draft file.
expected_result: File is discarded. No active file retained. Audit log records discard action.

purpose: Verify forwarding an active circulated file to a new recipient (Zero Onward Traversal context).
preconditions: File is in 'Active / Circulated' state. User is the current holder. Recipient is valid and different from previous sender.
action_or_input: Forward file to new recipient with mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: File held by new recipient. Previous holder no longer has active control. History and audit updated. Notification sent.

purpose: Verify onward forwarding of a received file (One Loop Traversal).
preconditions: User has received an active circulated file. User is the current holder.
action_or_input: Forward file to next recipient with mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: File held by next recipient. History records onward movement. Notification sent.

purpose: Verify returning an active circulated file to the previous sender.
preconditions: User has received an active circulated file. Previous sender is known.
action_or_input: Return file to previous sender with mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: File held by previous sender. History records return action. Return notification triggered.

purpose: Verify archival of a completed circulated file by the owner.
preconditions: File is in 'Active / Circulated' state. User is the file owner. Collaborative objective is complete.
expected_result: File state changes to 'Archived / Read-only'. File cannot be modified or forwarded. Archive notification triggered. Audit log updated.

purpose: Verify that a non-owner cannot archive a file.
preconditions: File is in 'Active / Circulated' state. User is an associated employee but NOT the file owner.
expected_result: Action is denied. Error message indicates lack of permission/ownership.

purpose: Verify that an already archived file cannot be archived again or modified.
action_or_input: Attempt to archive, forward, or edit the file.
expected_result: All actions are denied. File remains read-only.

purpose: Verify that forwarding a file fails without a mandatory movement comment.
preconditions: File is in 'Draft' or 'Active' state. User is authorized sender.
action_or_input: Attempt to forward file with empty movement comment.
expected_result: Action is denied. Validation error requires mandatory comment.

purpose: Verify that creating a file fails without a mandatory initial comment.
action_or_input: Attempt to create new file with empty initial comment.
expected_result: Action is denied. Validation error requires mandatory initial comment.

purpose: Verify that a circulated file cannot be discarded.
expected_result: Action is denied. Discard is only allowed for pre-circulation drafts.
